notes.title: Some currency price adjustments
notes.notes: Hello fellow players, currently some currency prices of [Sex Formula] have been updated. Before the launch, players were informed that the price was 1.33 times that of [Succubus Cafe]. However, the author did not carefully calculate the price after automatically calculating it. Checking the difference of each currency has resulted in the difference of some currencies being higher than 1.33 times. Currently, the currency with excessive difference has been adjusted to 1.33 times. Players who have already purchased please confirm that there is no change in the purchase price. If there is any change, please refund first. , to avoid losses, thank you for your understanding (I will pay attention to it later...).
